findings.finding: Technical/harness status and global product status are distinct in the actual content: both result roots say overall PASS and target_qa_certified true, but completion_certified false, human false, headquarters NOT_RUN/NOT_ACCEPTED; sales product/stable/release certifications are not granted. findings.finding: Information hierarchy obscures acceptance scope. SUMMARY leads with QA COMPLETE and Overall Result PASS before clarifying processing-only meaning. HTML h1 is PASS; the explicit Acceptance status/HOLD block follows the main 94-row or 85-row test table. A reader must pass a large technical detail section before seeing acceptance boundaries.

Run2/report.html h1 and Acceptance status DOM order
findings.limit: A model communication judgment, not measured reader misunderstanding. Source order is verified; actual viewport/pixel layout was not rendered.

findings.finding: Sales readbacks correctly preserve NOT_RUN rather than inventing reviewed quality from recording presence. The first 30s/5min phases carry no outcome/findings in these original reports, shelf/readability are absent, human=false and model-proxy-is-not-human reason is explicit. This later independent audit does not retroactively replace those original statuses.
findings.limit: A cold_start=true software fresh-extraction provenance flag is not proof of a fresh human or uninformed evaluator; resumed blind audit retains its separate exposure limitation.
